sources.title: NVIDIA regulatory quarterly economics and cash conversion
sources.policy_note: Public attributed issuer report; robots and source access enforced by existing acquire. Personal noncommercial research retains at most three short excerpts and hashes; no full document or redistribution licence claimed. Issuer statements, unaudited results and management estimates are distinct from audited investor ROI or price forecasts. SEC regulatory filing on publicly permitted EDGAR path; original issuer copyright is not assumed public domain.

excerpts.quote: Five direct customers accounted for 22 %, 14 %, 13 %, 11 %, and 10 % of our accounts receivable balance as of July 26, 2026. Three direct customers accounted for 25 %, 18 %, and 13 % of our accounts receivable balance as of January 25, 2026. Payment from customers is generally due shortly after delivery of our products. In certain cases, for investment-grade customer purchases, we have and may in the future provide longer payment terms ranging from 90 days up to one year to assist customers with large data center builds depending on size.
